label: GO step choosing a1 after an unrewarded trial (sparse subset)
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2), only when the D1 reward input was 0 (previous trial unrewarded; never after reward or penalty), and essentially only when the agent picks a1 (model_act==1 holds 99.9% of mass; a2 choices are ~0, and rate rises with the a1 policy logit). This conjunction is a near-necessary condition (dev recall 0.996, mass recall 0.999) but only ~19% of such steps are active, so the unit fires on a sparse subset. Adding the hidden good state (good==S1, 84% of mass), prev_common==0, a reward two trials back, high value, or a large a1 logit did not raise precision above ~0.23. Activity also depends strongly on episode position: rare in trials 0-19, peaks around trials 40-79, and is almost silent after trial 85, suggesting a slowly drifting hidden-state component that gates the threshold crossing and is not captured by any task variable. Recorded predicate uses only observed inputs plus the agent own choice.
